knownGaps.why: Genuine limitation, the same shape as openai-pricing. A cost page quotes $0.0000167 per 1,000 requests beside $1,045.88 monthly totals. The page grid is set from the median, and the per-amount significant-figure cap plus the round-to-zero escape hatch then pull the extremes apart in both directions.

Genuine limitation. $0.00001953 per request is 0.00000002504 ZEC. The rule that a nonzero price must never render as 0.00 expands it to eleven decimals. Whether a price this small should convert at all is the open question openai-pricing already raised.
